ops.title: A3.12: guard str(exc) in the accounting epilogue's abort path (in released 0.5.0/0.5.1)

ops.text: reason stringification in the epilogue's except block is guarded (fallback to type(exc).__name__/repr on failure) so a broken __str__ can neither escape the finally nor suppress the latch write
test: custom driver recover_cost raising an Exception whose __str__ raises → latch present, original exception propagates by identity
